@@ -6632,0 +6632,31 @@ + When preview features are enabled, the following restrictions apply to + and + events: +
    +
  • + An event for a watched instance field is not generated while the object + containing the field is being constructed by the event thread if the + object's class or any of its superclasses has + + strictly-initializedPREVIEW instance fields. + For this purpose, the VM considers an object to be under construction + if the event thread has an active constructor invocation where slot 0 + of the local variable array contains a reference to the object and + the constructor's declaring class or any of its superclasses has + strictly-initialized instance fields. +
    • +
  • + An event for a watched static field is not generated when the class + declaring the field is being initialized by the event thread and the + class declares + + strictly-initializedPREVIEW static fields. +
    • +
+

+ API Note: + The instance fields of + + value classesPREVIEW are strictly-initialized. + Consequently, events for watched instance fields of a value class are not + generated during construction of an instance of the value class.
